# The conveyor starts after the planned robot trajectory has finished.
PROGRAM feeder
WAIT_SET robot_done TIMEOUT 80
SET start 1
WAIT_SET arrived TIMEOUT 12
END

PROGRAM conveyor
WAIT_SET start TIMEOUT 80
MOVE_MODEL tray X 0.65 TICKS 4
SET arrived 1
END
